execution.method: local script streamed to the existing server container over stdin

contract_conclusions: A 50-address pools/multi request is supported for both configured chains.
m5/m15/m30 transaction windows, volume breakdown, and composition were complete in both 50-pool fixtures.
Unknown pool addresses are omitted from an otherwise successful response, so results must be joined by normalized address rather than array position.
Mutable pool data changed after 11 seconds on both chains, supporting a conservative 10-second cache TTL.
Concurrency 2 and 4 both completed without HTTP errors or 429 in this bounded test.
launchpad_details was absent from attributes, relationships, and included resources across both 50-pool fixtures even when requested; it is not a universal Level 1 contract field.
The measured credit delta was 66 for 26 HTTP requests, so request count must not be treated as credit count.
